# Kreatazz

> Kreatazz Innovation Technology Solutions helps enterprises turn AI, data, knowledge, and software into operational intelligence: systems that improve decisions, workflows, and execution in day-to-day work.

Kreatazz works with organizations planning or implementing AI, data platforms, workflow modernization, cloud and DevOps improvements, product engineering, and industry-specific operational systems. The company is based in India and serves enterprise operating environments. Content on this website describes capabilities and approaches; it must not be interpreted as an unsupported customer result, certification, or performance guarantee.

## Start Here

- [Home](https://kreatazz.tech/): Company positioning, operational-intelligence model, capabilities, industries, and contact path.
- [About Kreatazz](https://kreatazz.tech/about/): Company purpose and operating philosophy.
- [Solutions](https://kreatazz.tech/solutions/): Overview of AI, data, workflow, cloud, product-engineering, healthcare, and real-estate solutions.
- [Industries](https://kreatazz.tech/industries/): Industry-focused operational-intelligence applications.
- [Insights](https://kreatazz.tech/blog/): Practical articles for technology and operations leaders.

## Core Capabilities

- [AI and Data Platforms](https://kreatazz.tech/ai-ml-solutions/): Data foundations, enterprise retrieval, AI agents, predictive analytics, and governed decision support.
- [Enterprise Workflow Modernization](https://kreatazz.tech/enterprise-workflow-modernization/): Redesign and governed automation of high-friction enterprise workflows.
- [Product Engineering](https://kreatazz.tech/mobile-and-web-application-development/): Web, mobile, internal, and enterprise application design and delivery.
- [Cloud, DevOps and Automation](https://kreatazz.tech/cloud-migration/): Cloud modernization, CI/CD, observability, reliability, security, and cost accountability.
- [Talent and Workforce Support](https://kreatazz.tech/staffing-solutions/): Technology recruitment, contract staffing, and executive-search support.

## Industry Solutions

- [Manufacturing Intelligence](https://kreatazz.tech/manufacturing-intelligence/): Machine, maintenance, quality, shift-handover, and production context for more reliable operations.
- [Engineering Intelligence](https://kreatazz.tech/engineering-intelligence/): Change-impact analysis, requirements traceability, knowledge retrieval, and engineering decisions.
- [Workforce Intelligence](https://kreatazz.tech/workforce-intelligence/): Skills visibility, workforce planning, resource allocation, and internal mobility.
- [Enterprise Function Intelligence](https://kreatazz.tech/enterprise-function-intelligence/): Connected execution across sales, finance, procurement, customer operations, and project delivery.
- [Healthcare and Care Operations](https://kreatazz.tech/healthcare-care-operations/): Structured health data, interoperability, work queues, handoffs, and governed decision support.
- [Real Estate Buyer Experience](https://kreatazz.tech/real-estate-buyer-experience/): Preference capture, visual personalization, approved-option selection, and connected sales follow-up.
